Interface GUI

public interface GUI
Factory of host-styled Swing components for plugins, plus static Swing helpers.

The host application (e.g., emuStudio) implements the factory methods and provides the instance via ApplicationApi.getGUI(). Panel layout constraints are MigLayout strings.

  • Method Details

    • loadIcon

      static ImageIcon loadIcon(String resource, Class<?> resourceClass)
      Loads an icon from a resource. If a matching resource with @2x before the file extension exists (e.g. icon@2x.png for icon.png), it is used for high-resolution rendering.
      Parameters:
      resource - resource path; relative paths are resolved against resourceClass
      resourceClass - class whose classloader is used for resource lookup
      Returns:
      loaded icon, or null if the base resource could not be found

    • loadFontResource

      static Font loadFontResource(String path, Class<?> resourceClass, int size)
      Loads and registers a plain true-type font with kerning enabled.
      Parameters:
      path - resource path; relative paths are resolved against resourceClass
      resourceClass - class whose classloader is used for resource lookup
      size - font size
      Returns:
      loaded font, or a plain Font.MONOSPACED font if the font could not be loaded

    • shortenToFit

      static String shortenToFit(String text, Component component, int width)
      Shortens text to fit the given width when rendered with the component's font.

      The text is cut in the middle, keeping a prefix and suffix around "..."; Unicode characters (grapheme clusters) are kept intact. If even "..." does not fit, only the dots that fit are returned.

      Parameters:
      text - text to shorten
      component - component whose font is used for measuring
      width - available width in pixels; non-positive widths produce an empty string
      Returns:
      text, or its shortened form that fits the width
